units.source_text: 他正想往小屋背后兜上一圈，忽然从里面窜出一条黑影。

en.t: Just as he was about to circle around behind the hut, a black shadow suddenly darted out from inside.

units.source_text: 矮胖得像头猪。

en.t: It was squat and fat, like a pig.

units.source_text: 细一看，原来是一条红狗。

en.t: Looking more closely, he saw that it was a reddish dog.

units.source_text: 吓唬它可不行，到那边去！

en.t: Trying to scare it would not work. Get over there!

units.source_text: 谁知，狗紧紧盯着男人，一点儿也没见退缩的迹象。

en.t: But the dog stared hard at the man, showing not the slightest sign of backing away.

units.source_text: 它一边的耳朵耷拉着，有一双不相称的小眼睛，给人一种十分阴森的感觉。

en.t: One of its ears drooped, and its mismatched little eyes gave off an intensely sinister feeling.

units.source_text: 狗的鼻孔翕动着。

en.t: The dog's nostrils twitched.

units.source_text: 大概要叫起来吧？

en.t: Was it about to start barking?

units.source_text: 你敢叫叫看……

en.t: Just try barking, if you dare...

units.source_text: 他手伸到口袋里捏住剪子……

en.t: He slipped his hand into his pocket and gripped the scissors...

units.source_text: 它叫的话，就叫它脑袋开花！

en.t: If it barked, he would split its head open!

units.source_text: 那狗一声没吭，默默地盯着这边。

en.t: The dog made no sound and silently stared this way.

units.source_text: 是条野狗吧？……

en.t: It must be a stray, right?...

units.source_text: 没有光泽，稀稀拉拉的秃毛……

en.t: Its dull fur was patchy and thinning...

units.source_text: 像患过皮肤病似的，鼻脸上净是疮痂……

en.t: As if it had suffered from a skin disease, its muzzle was covered with scabs...

units.source_text: 听说不叫的狗，最危险……

en.t: They say dogs that do not bark are the most dangerous...

units.source_text: 妈的，应该带点什么吃的来……

en.t: Damn it, he should have brought something to eat...

units.source_text: 是呵，说起食物来，他忽然想起忘记带走氰化钾了……

en.t: Yes, and speaking of food, he suddenly remembered that he had forgotten to take the potassium cyanide with him...

units.source_text: 算了，女人也不会注意藏氰化钾的地方吧……

en.t: Never mind, the woman probably would not notice where the potassium cyanide was hidden...

units.source_text: 他小声吹了声口哨，伸出手去，想吸引狗的注意力……

en.t: He gave a soft whistle and reached out his hand, trying to draw the dog's attention...

units.source_text: 作为回答，那条狗翻起了熏制鲱鱼似的嘴唇，缝隙间，露出了沾满沙子的黄板牙……

en.t: In answer, the dog curled back its lips like smoked herring, exposing sandy yellow buckteeth through the gap...

units.source_text: 这家伙，难道看到我就勾起食欲了吗？……

en.t: This thing, had the sight of me actually whetted its appetite?...

units.source_text: 实在讨厌它那粗大的喉咙……

en.t: He truly hated that thick throat of its...

units.source_text: 戳它一下，要是能把它迅速制服就好了……

en.t: If only he could jab it once and quickly subdue it...
